title: Fix model default mismatch in chat_with_openai call_tool handler
description: In server.py call_tool(), chat_with_openai is called with default model='gpt-4o' (line 205), but the tool schema and the function signature both default to 'gpt-5'. The call_tool handler overrides the function's own default, creating inconsistent behavior. The handler default should be removed so the function's default (gpt-5) takes effect, or both should be aligned.

title: Migrate secret retrieval from .env/dotenv to pass (password-store)
description: On the develop branch, all API keys (OPENAI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY) are loaded via python-dotenv from a .env file. The standard for the shop is to use pass (password-store) for secrets. The claude/keychain-migration branch attempted this but used macOS Keychain + Proton Pass -- the canonical pattern is 'from passstore import get_secret' or 'pass show <name>' per global CLAUDE.md. Implement pass-based secret retrieval, remove python-dotenv dependency.
